question: everything I entered vanished after refreshing the page

articles.title: Why your changes disappear when you reload
articles.body:
This is a demonstration copy of Harbour CRM. It stores everything in your browser's memory only.

Reloading the page resets all contacts, companies, deals, custom fields and settings to the original sample data. Nothing you enter is sent anywhere.
